summary.title: Calvin & Hobbes Search Engine
summary.one_liner: A fan-made tribute page that lets you search the Calvin & Hobbes comic strip by text, built by Michael "Bing" Yingling.
keywords: find calvin and hobbes strip by quote
takeaways: The page is a fan tribute and research tool for searching Calvin & Hobbes strips.
Script text comes from a Scribd document, likely by S. Anand, and strip dates come from Wikipedia.
The comic and characters are copyright Bill Watterson and Andrews McMeel Universal.
The page states it is meant for research purposes only.
summary.summary: This page is a fan-made tribute to the Calvin & Hobbes comic strip, presenting a search engine for its content, created by Michael "Bing" Yingling. The page credits the script as coming from a Scribd document likely by S. Anand, the dates from Wikipedia, and the font by Martijn Reemst outlined with pyrochild's outline plugin. The page text contains no technical details about how the search works, and it is repeated twice. Copyright is attributed to Bill Watterson and Andrews McMeel Universal.
